text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to roll feature_x out as a micro-slice ramp today. Need a quick sync on percent increments, smoke checks, and who will own a rollback if something flares. Target window: 17:30-19:30 PT.

aj: I can own the step increases. Plan I had in mind: 0.5% -> 2% -> 8% -> 25% over ~2h. Wait 20m between each step, run smoke checks after each.

sam: +1 on the pacing. Propose smoke checklist: 1) 95th p99 latency for /generate <= 450ms, 2) error rate < 0.3% (5xx+timeouts), 3) CPU/GPU queue depth not rising > 15% from baseline. If any fail, rollback immediately.

lee: Who's doing the quick verification for model quality? We should sample outputs for our regression testset (50 queries) after the 8% step. I can run that if someone triggers the job.

maria: @aj please run the rollout CLI and ping when you bump to 2% and 8%. @lee ping me when regression job finishes. I'll keep an eye on dashboards + SLOs.

aj: Deploy bot will post statuses but I'll also post manual notes. Schedule:
- 17:30 PT: start 0.5% (smoke run 10m)
- 17:50 PT: bump to 2% (smoke run 20m)
- 18:20 PT: bump to 8% + trigger regression job (20m)
- 18:45 PT: bump to 25% (final monitor 45m)

sam: Quick fail criteria (automated):
- increase in 5xx > 0.2 percentage points over baseline OR
- sustained p99 latency > 500ms for 5m OR
- error budget burn > 1% in 15m
If any of these happen, automated rollback will start and alert the oncall.

lee: Regression job command (will run in ci/regress):
```
./ci/regress --suite feature_x_smoke --samples 50 --env prod-preview
```
I'll post the pass/fail summary to this thread.

aj: Rollback plan: immediate toggle off via feature-flag manager (FF): `ffctl set feature_x off --reason "auto-rollback"` then scale model-pool back to previous weights if needed. Oncall will run the `rollback-validate.sh` smoke script.

maria: Who is primary oncall tonight?

aj: Oncall is sam until 18:00 PT, then lee picks up. So sam covers initial steps and will triage alerts from the 0.5% and 2% ramps.

sam: I'll be watching alerts and dash. If I see anything borderline I'll escalate to @maria and start rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted: "rollout feature_x: start 0.5% — initiated by aj" :rocket:

aj: 17:30 -> 0.5% live. smoke check started.

lee: Regression job queued, ETA ~15m.

aj: 17:40 -> smoke pass at 0.5%. Bumping to 2%.

sam: Not seeing errors in SLOs, latency steady. :thumbsup:

aj: 18:12 -> bumping to 8% now. Triggering regression job.

lee: Regression done — 50 samples, 2 failures (semantic drift in two prompts). Details in ci/regress artefacts link: https://ci.internal/reports/1905554321. Sending sample diffs.

maria: Can you paste the two diffs here? If they look noisy we can continue; if systemic we rollback.

lee: pasted diffs. Both look like tokenization edge cases, not generation quality regressions. I recommend continuing to 25% but keep close watch for customer-facing prompts.

sam: Based on metrics + regress, I'm OK to continue. Proceed to 25% but reduce observation window to 30m and keep alerts at low threshold.

aj: 18:45 -> 25% live. Monitoring.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted: "rollout feature_x: reached 25% — stable so far" :white_check_mark:

maria: Great job everyone. After 30m of stable at 25% we'll schedule a follow-up to decide next steps (full launch vs extended ramp). If anything degrades, follow rollback steps above and notify infra & product.

lee: I'll upload the regression artifacts and brief note to the release ticket.

sam: I'll leave the alerting rule pinned for 60m.

aj: Thanks all — I'll mark this rollout as complete in the release doc. :tada:
